whatIsIt.eli5: Grades how well each guessed box covers the real box.
whatIsIt.simple: Complete-IoU loss: 1 − IoU, plus penalties for the distance between box centres and for different shapes (aspect ratio). Weight 7.5 by default.
whatIsIt.engineer: L = 1 − IoU + ρ²(b, b_gt)/c² + αv; weighted by the TAL target score; gain box = 7.5.

whyExists.eli5: A box that is in the wrong place or the wrong shape should be fixed.
whyExists.simple: Plain IoU gives no signal when boxes do not overlap; the extra CIoU terms still pull the box toward the target.
whyExists.engineer: CIoU adds centre-distance and aspect-ratio consistency terms for faster, more stable regression.
